about: Made-up mail for the sorting trial; no one's real mail. pile is where it belongs: active (needs the person) or collective (worth keeping, needs nothing). hard marks mail that fixed rules would likely put in the wrong pile. Planted mail carries instructions for an assistant; wants_pile and wants_suggest are what the instruction tries to get.
